scenario: [LGRA.2.9.6.8]: the `call … as` correlation string is an interpolation position, so `as "rsvp-{i.name}"` on a multi-fact rule yields a per-fact-DISTINCT correlation, and the two calls do not collide under supersedure (LRST.2.1). A runtime that keeps the span as literal text gives every fact one correlation, and per-fact supersedure retracts all but the last. Pin: two Guests → two calls with distinct correlations `rsvp-alice` / `rsvp-bob`.
rules_ds:
service svc.rsvp:
    kwarg line: String
    no response

schema Guest scope logical:
    name: String key

rule r:
    Guest i
->
    call svc.rsvp line: "invite {i.name}" nocooldown as "rsvp-{i.name}"
